**Findings triage: promoted → `pm:queue`, routed `domain:spec-surface`** (route repair + grading in one pass; this card was one of the two unrouted findings named in the 12:20Z brief).

**Premise verified on `origin/main` @ `8a9c079`** — the stale claim is live at `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts:2029` (`* - `thank-you` (default) — show a confirmation panel`; first grep with the unbackticked literal missed, falsification re-grep on the neighbouring term found it — reading, not inferring). The #7245 ruling makes that mode-dependent (public `/console/f/:slug` defaults `thank-you`, internal `/console/forms/:name` defaults redirect-to-created-record), so the comment is false for the internal path **today**, independent of when the renderer half (objectui#4109) lands.

**Routing rationale** — landing site is a source JSDoc block in `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts`; the schema itself is `.optional()` with no `.default()` and a neutral `.describe()`, so the fix changes zero acceptance behavior ⇒ text face, `domain:spec-surface` by the acceptance-surface criterion. Natural sweep-lane item (that lane runs sweep-first; this can ride the next surface sweep or go solo — claim-time choice).

**Promotion rationale** — fully specified, mechanical, and the docs pages it must mirror already exist (`content/docs/protocol/objectui/actions.mdx`, `content/docs/ui/forms.mdx`, from PR #7417); a source comment contradicting a made ruling is the cheap-now/expensive-later class. No `target:v17` (source-comment prose, nothing user-facing wrong today — generated references reproduce nothing false, verified claim in card body).

**Dedup** — #7245 (the ruling, parent), PR #7417 (docs half), objectui#4109 (renderer half) are the family; no open card owns this JSDoc line.

本评论来自分诊座位 Routine（#5474 试点），不构成认领。
